title: Cues about the heart rate zone you chose
description: A change of zone can be heard without constantly looking at the watch.

blocks.text: The user wants to learn about the heart rate zone they chose without constantly looking at the watch. The review asks for notifications outright; that is more precise than an assumption that the existing alerts are already too frequent.

quote.text: What I would love to see is the ability to turn on heart rate zone notifications so I know what zone I'm in, whether I need to slow down or pick up the pace.

blocks.text: Reporting the change you asked for
Let the range and the conditions for a message be set: only on leaving it, for example. Show how old the measurement is and allow repeated alerts to be switched off during the session.
What stays the person’s decision here
The app reports the measured value and how it relates to the chosen range. It should not pass the notification itself off as grounds to increase the load, or promise better fitness.
